text: Coffee with Imani. Her mum is moving in with them on 14 November, which she's dreading a bit. Her brother Sam is driving the van down the day before. I should drop round a casserole the week after.

Gareth got made redundant on Friday. Says he's fine but he clearly isn't. His wife Kerry has gone back to full time at the hospital to cover the mortgage. Need to ring him next week, properly, not just a text.

Long call with Saanvi. Viewing a flat in Leith on 3rd of June, then another in Portobello the next day. Her partner Rohan wants the one with the garden. She's vegetarian now, btw, so no more burger nights.
Dafydd's dad died last Tuesday. Funeral is 21/10 at Llandaff, wake at the rugby club afterwards. I'm driving Owen and Joy up that morning. Remind me to send flowers to his mum the day before.
Zara and Darius split up. Not messy apparently, he's moving back to Bristol at the end of the month and she keeps the flat and the dog, Biscuit. She seemed okay, sort of relieved.
Bumped into Akira at the station. Her son Kenji starts at uni in Glasgow on 22 September and she's already counting the days till reading week. Works at the library now, loves it.
Kieran's housewarming is off, landlord pulled the flat at the last minute. He's sofa surfing at his brother Emil's for now. Don't forget to send him that lettings agent's number.
Dimitri and his wife Katarzyna are moving to Lisbon! Flights booked for 9 January. Their kids are going to an international school out there. Leaving do probably the Saturday before, he'll confirm.
Ming told me her grandad passed away in the night. She's flying to Kuala Lumpur tomorrow and the funeral is a week after. Message her on Thursday, don't expect a reply.

Notes from lunch with Siddharth. Promoted to head of logistics, starts the new role 1st of December. His dad's hip op went well, home on 2 Oct. He's still mad about cricket, wants the new Ashes book. Good Christmas present.

Had a proper catch up with Lola. She got the keys to the house in Frome yesterday and the move is 28 Feb. Her mum Dorota is coming over from Kraków to help the week before. Lola's nervous about the mortgage but excited too. I should offer to help paint the weekend after, and maybe get them a plant for the new place.

Rachel says Lukas got let go along with half his team. Formal meeting on 5 November, then garden leave. She's worried he'll go quiet like last time. Their eldest Mia is doing GCSEs this year too, so lots going on.
Eamon's mum's funeral was today. Lovely service. His sister Niamh read the eulogy and barely got through it. Check in with him at the weekend, and maybe again a week after when everyone's gone home.
Oscar has finally moved to Manchester. Started at the BBC on Monday, living in Ancoats with two flatmates. Misses his cat Pickle, who's staying with his parents for now.
Ibrahim Khan rang. Wedding is still 14 May but they've moved the venue to Bath. His fiancée Demi wants everyone in green. RSVP by end of the month.

Joseph and Kiri are viewing houses in Hastings on Saturday and then a second viewing the day after if it goes well. Kiri's pregnant, due in March, so they want to be in before. Joseph's mum is helping with the deposit.
Ethan got dumped. Six years with Anders, out of nowhere. He's staying with his parents in Leeds till 3rd of Jan at least. Need to call him tonight, and text Owen so he knows too.
Sunil's leaving drinks were last night. Great send off. He moves to Singapore on 12/11 and his wife Ming follows a fortnight after with the kids. Remind me to ask how the first week went.
Dentist at 9 on 4 Nov, then car MOT the morning after. Must sort the gas bill before the 10th.

Talked to Joy for ages after choir. Her brother Gareth is struggling since the redundancy, barely leaving the house. Her dad has his cataract surgery on 18 October and she's taking him. She wants to do a pottery course in the new year.
Kerry's nan died at 97. Funeral is next Thursday, she's doing a reading and is terrified about it. Text her good luck that morning.
Demi says Rohan's moving out of London, finally. Viewing places in Norwich on 7th of Dec. His girlfriend Imani is staying put till her contract ends in spring.
Saw Dorota at the school gate. Her daughter Lola is moving back home after the breakup. Dorota's thrilled and also not. Their dog Rolo is fourteen now, vet on Friday about his legs.
Katarzyna messaged: they exchanged contracts! Completion is 30 November and the removal men come the day before. Send a card to the new address afterwards.
Darius. Allergic to shellfish, supports Spurs, hates being called Daz. Brother Emil is the loud one.

Imani's mum is in hospital again, chest infection. She's going up to Birmingham on Saturday and staying till the 3rd. Her husband Kieran is holding the fort with their twins. I should offer to take the twins on Sunday afternoon.
Gareth Hughes, aka Gaz, finally sold the flat. Moving into his girlfriend Zara's place on 1st of March. He's selling all his furniture, wants the sofa gone by 20/02.

Akira's company is closing the Leeds office. Consultation starts 3 Nov and she'll know by Christmas whether she's being relocated or let go. Her partner Owen says they won't move to London, full stop. She's really anxious about it. Must ask her how the first consultation went.
Lunch with Dr Moreau, Oscar's mum. Oscar's moving in with his boyfriend in Leeds next month. She keeps bees and wants honey jars, if I see any nice ones.
Kiri and Joseph's engagement party is cancelled, Joseph's grandad is very ill. They're going down to Cornwall on Friday to be with him.
Uncle Sunil called. Auntie Ming's knee replacement is 12 January and she'll need lifts to physio for a few weeks after. Cousin Rohan is doing Mondays. I'm doing Wednesdays.
Lola's dad passed away in the summer and she says the first anniversary of her mum's death is coming up too, 16 Nov. She doesn't want a fuss, just company. I should take her for a walk that day.
Note to self: viewing the two bed on Elm Road at 6 tomorrow, then the one by the park on Saturday. Bring the damp meter and ask about the service charge.
Ethan's new flat is lovely. Top floor, Walthamstow, he moved in 2 weeks ago. His sister Demi is moving in with him in January while she does her master's.

Emil Popescu and his wife Kerry are splitting up. They're telling the kids this weekend. He's moving to his brother's in Croydon the week after. Feels like he needs a friend right now, ring him on Monday.
Dimitri says his mum's diagnosis is confirmed. Starting chemo on 6th of November, first session that morning at the Royal Marsden. His brother Andreas is flying in from Athens the day before.
Rachel's started at Ofsted, likes it so far. Her husband Joseph is hunting for jobs up north because they want to move to York by next summer. Their son Leo is obsessed with trains.

Catch up with Siddharth and Saanvi. They're moving to Dundee on 2nd of August for her new lectureship. Siddharth is leaving the firm on 25 July, leaving lunch the same day. Saanvi's parents are coming over from Pune for a month afterwards to help settle the kids. Siddharth seemed a bit flat about the whole thing, worried about finding work up there. Don't forget to send him the Dundee contact from Anders.
Kieran's grandma died. Funeral 8/11, he asked me to be a bearer. I've said yes. Need to get the suit dry cleaned before then.
Owen's in bits. His girlfriend Joy ended things on Sunday and he has to move out by 31 Oct. His mum has offered the spare room. He's applying for flats near work.
Text from Dafydd: moved in! The kids have already claimed the biggest bedroom. His wife Imani wants a big Christmas at the new place, 24th of December, everyone invited.
Katarzyna is struggling a lot since her dad died. She took a week off work and hasn't been sleeping. Her husband Lukas has been brilliant. Check in with her again Friday.
Picked up the boxes from the post office. Still need tape and bubble wrap.
Zara's sister Kiri is moving to Auckland on 15 March for good. Big farewell dinner the Saturday before. Zara's putting a brave face on it.
Lukas Tanaka called about the reunion. It's on 3rd of May in Sheffield. Gareth can't make it, he's at his son's graduation that day.
Anders and Rachel finally moved into the house in Didsbury. Their kids start at the new primary on Monday. Rachel's mum is visiting a week after. Remind me to ask how the kids got on.

Darius lost his job last month and his landlord's selling up too, so he has to be out by 12 January. Viewing a flat on 4 Dec and another the next day. He's being really calm about it, almost too calm. His brother Emil says he's job hunting in Leeds.
Mrs Ahmed next door told me her son Ibrahim's divorce came through. He's moving back in with her for a bit. She's glad of the company honestly.
Joy says her son Ethan has his driving test on 9th of Nov, third attempt, and he's a nervous wreck. Her daughter is home from uni the weekend after.

Coffee with Ming. She loves the new place in Bristol but misses London. Her partner Sunil's job is going well. She's learning Portuguese for their trip to Porto on 18 April. Dropped a hint she'd love a proper Portuguese cookbook.
Ibrahim told me his mum died in March. He didn't want to talk about it much. He's moved into her old house in Hull with his wife Saanvi.
Emil's dog Bruno went missing on Saturday. Found him Monday morning in someone's shed. Emil hasn't stopped hugging him.

Big catch up with Demi and Kerry. Demi's leaving London for Glasgow, flights on 5 January, new job at the uni starts the week after. Kerry is helping her pack the weekend before. Kerry's own news: her dad has been made redundant after 30 years at the plant and she's worried about him. Remind me to ask Demi how the first week went, and send Kerry's dad a card.
Oscar's girlfriend Akira is in the Edinburgh half on 17th of May. He's training with her. Afterwards they're doing a week in Skye.
Eamon and his partner Kieran are moving to Cardiff on 1 Dec, his mum lives there and isn't well. Leaving drinks are the Friday before at the Crown. I'm doing the playlist.

Saw Dorota. Her husband died two years ago and she's finally selling the house, viewers this Saturday. She wants to move nearer her daughter Katarzyna in Reading. She seemed lighter than I've seen her in ages.
Phoned Rohan. His mum's funeral was on 30/09. He's back at work but tired. His girlfriend Lola is taking him to the coast on 26 October for a few days. Message him when they're back.
Gareth's mum is moving into a care home on 10 November. He's selling her flat afterwards. He's sorting it all by himself, his brother's useless. I should offer to help clear the flat.
Weekend sorted: tip run Saturday, then Mum's for lunch on Sunday. Need to pick up the keys from the agent before 5 on Friday.

Ran into Zara and Darius, back together apparently. They're house hunting in Brighton, offer in on a two bed. Zara's brother Ethan is their mortgage broker. Big celebration dinner if it goes through, she said 28th of Nov.
